title: Logical candidate sets for a tenant order feed
method: Synthetic table contains 1,000,000 orders,10,000 in one tenant and 500 pending within that tenant. Counts describe logical predicate populations, not physical index visits or measured speedups. Actual work depends on the execution plan and data layout.
alt: Logical candidate sets for a tenant order feed. All orders: 1e+06 rows; Tenant orders: 10000 rows; Tenant pending orders: 500 rows. Illustrative values.
